issues.message: Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: red_banner, cornflower, carved_pumpkin, candle.
439 blocks, over the common budget of 350 (docs/STRUCTURES.md). A warning only.

notes.detail: Shutters on both long sides, a weapon-rack fence, barrel bench, log pile, hay bale, banner and leaf bushes: the long sides are now rich.
notes.depth: Shutters help the long sides, but the back wall and both gables are still flat planes.
notes.roof: Unchanged: flat spruce colour, untrimmed gables.

visual.summary: L2 plus shutters, an outdoor weapon rack and bench, a log pile, a red banner and bushes; the finished barracks looks lived in from the sides and front.
problems: Back wall (z=12) still has no window or detail apart from the chimney: the back view is the weakest of all three levels.
Gables still plain spruce planks; a dark oak beam or verge trim would finish the roof.
Reach: unchanged from L1; only roof slopes unreached (fine).
